notes.title: Release Date Adjustment
notes.notes:
As development has moved forward, we've recognized the potential for more in-depth gameplay and the ability to reach a broader market. 

To realize this goal, we have pushed the release date back to a more achievable date and time. However, between now and then we will be opening up a closed beta test for interested players. We are currently running a very small closed alpha test to flesh out the current game modes and to ensure the concept is well realized. 

We will be announcing the start of the Beta-Test sometime in the coming months. If you're interested in taking part, there will be a signup posted at that time. 

Thank you for your interest in our game and we look forward to having a match with you soon!

notes.title: Saniya Update
notes.notes:
Version Number: Saniya Update

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed: Scoreboard keeps scores of players who have left until the game is closed.
-Fixed: Game setting box stretch issue covering leave button in lobby for players with monitors with large aspect ratios. 
-Fixed: On lost connection players do not respawn and do not get kicked to main menu.
-Fixed: Joining match after it has started results in all dead bodies of previous kills appearing at join.

Improvements:
-Max player name length added and scoreboard fix for wrapping player names
-Adjusted lighting angle in all arenas in order to cast shorter shadows.
-Slightly zoomed out the camera on all arena levels.
-Aim Line defaults to “Active” for all new games.
-Sound now plays when player joins and when player leaves a match.

New Features and System Changes:
-Aiming system now based around camera center rather than the player as the center point.
-Camera no longer focuses on the player but a point farther down along the aim line.
-Added a Kill log to the arena.
-Added the Shotgun
-Added selectable default weapon
-Added Weapon and Item Pickup system
-Added Discord status message integration
-Added New Map
-Added New Character Model

notes.title: FPS Version Number: Braelyn Dev Log
notes.notes:
FPS Version Number: Braelyn Dev Log

Added features:

-Player Sprint/Running controls
-"Named" beta versions with displayed version in menus
-Added connection limitations based on version
	-Players can no longer attempt to connect with an incompatible hosted version of the game
-Enemy Players colored differently
-Added Player name tags to enemies
-Set fixed server region, now all players regardless of location should be able to connect to each others games
-Aiming line as gameplay option
-Editable Match settings
	-Map Selection
		-Two new map configurations for testing
			-90 degree map
			-Top-down camera map
	-Match duration
	-Respawn time
	-Max walking speed
	-Max running speed
	-Aiming line on/off

Fixes:

-Despawn dead bodies after 15 seconds
-Diagonal movement speed now matches straight-line movement speed
-Players now invisible while being relocated to spawn point
-Fixed spawning into floor if spawn system glitches.
-Fixed respawn system and changed the system to a host level request and tracking system
-Fixed a glitch allowing players to shoot through walls.

Upcoming Feature Updates:
-Weapon pickup system
-New Weapon
	-Shotgun
	-Bomb
-New Game modes
